name: Karthik Dantu
school: University at Buffalo, State University of New York
title: Associate Professor
fitReason: CART learns visual/proprioceptive terrain context to select high-level locomotion commands. VISION combines a web-scale VLM with constrained viewpoint planning for actual language-guided culvert inspection, giving concrete embodied AI projects beyond general SLAM.

physicalEvidence.summary: The June 2026 CART primary paper evaluates a physical Boston Dynamics Spot with ZED2i and additional IMU across rugged outdoor terrains, seven traversals per method. VISION’s primary project describes an actual Spot with gimballed camera/light in a66 m Erie Canal culvert, autonomously repositioning and re-imaging candidate regions.

shortVisit.summary: The live join page welcomes undergraduate/master’s research conversations subject to current commitments and separately mentions collaborators. It does not explicitly offer external internships or short visits. General master’s research interest is not counted as a short-visit pathway.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong learning-based terrain adaptation and VLM perception-to-action field robotics.
scoreReasons.physical: Explicit current primary hardware configuration and trial protocol plus infrastructure inspection field deployment.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: General master’s inquiry without explicit external visitor/intern pathway.

name: Prashant Doshi
title: UGA Foundation Distinguished Professor of Artificial Intelligence
department: School of Computing; Institute for Artificial Intelligence
fitReason: Recent work learns transferable rewards through abstract states (IJCAI 2026 per primary paper record), building on oDec-AIRL for teams where a human joins only when required. This is a focused reward-learning/coordination fit rather than a generalist VLA lab.

physicalEvidence.summary: The 2024 oDec-AIRL full primary paper includes a six-participant physical table-assembly pilot with a Franka Research 3, RealSense D435, AprilTags and hand tracking. Learned neural policy outputs are exported into a finite-state execution stack; the robot positions parts while humans screw them. Current UGA profile also describes 2025 cobot testing in onion sheds by InversAI, without establishing open visitor access to company sites.

shortVisit.summary: No current external-master’s short-visit invitation was verified. The THINC lab homepage failed retrieval, so recruitment coverage is incomplete. UGA’s central visitor framework is a possible administrative route, not a faculty opening.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong IRL and human-robot decision learning, narrower than foundation-model manipulation.
scoreReasons.physical: The fully inspected physical IRL pilot dates to 2024 and a MERL internship; current UGA-local hardware is not established.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No current external visit invitation; central university policy not scored as mentor capacity.
scoreReasons.freshness: Active 2026 theoretical/simulation work; best directly checked physical learning paper is 2024.
